name: What are the key steps in the remodeling project coordination process?

mainEntity.name: What are the key steps in the remodeling project coordination process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The remodeling project coordination process typically involves several key stages: initial consultation and needs assessment, detailed design and architectural planning, permit acquisition, material selection, construction execution, and final walkthrough. During the construction phase, Frasheski Construction manages scheduling of trades, site supervision, quality control, and communication with you. Our project managers ensure that each step progresses smoothly, coordinating subcontractors and deliveries to maintain the schedule and budget, ultimately streamlining the complexity of bringing your vision to life.
